purpose: Teach: 半月/高麗/理学部/無害/音痴/科学技術庁/初等/開発途上国

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、月経周期で半月の症状変化を医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Ren, we observe the symptom changes across half a menstrual cycle as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady, clinical but not cold. Even pace. Direct eye contact level. A physician laying out careful observation—precise, not rushed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、高麗人参の薬効を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, we're researching the medicinal properties of ginseng as a team.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Slight pause before the verb. Warm undertone—she's including him in the work, not speaking down. Breath steady.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、理学部出身の医師も医療チームで活躍します
lines.en: Ren, we have physicians from science backgrounds working on our team as well.
lines.style: Clear, even delivery. Light emphasis on 「also」—acknowledging what he's noticing. Composed but not detached. The tone of someone who answers what's actually being asked.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、無害成分の薬剤開発を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes, we're moving forward with developing drugs using harmless components.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Slight warmth on 「developing」—pride in the work itself. Measured pace. No rush. The voice of someone who trusts the process.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 発声機能の音痴的偏りを、貴院、評価されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital evaluates voice-tone irregularities quite carefully, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Genuine curiosity underneath—not flattery. Respectful distance. The careful phrasing of someone seeking confirmation, not challenge.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、旧科学技術庁基準を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Yes, we reference the old Science and Technology Agency standards in our team's work.
lines.style: Patient explanation. Grounded tone—not defensive about the older framework. Direct but not brief. She's answering what he's really asking beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 初等小児医療を、貴院、注力されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does focus on primary pediatric care, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Observant, almost gentle. Not quite a question—more of a reflection he's noticed and is offering back to her. Respectful pause at the comma. Soft landing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、開発途上国への医療支援を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Yes, we continue medical support work in developing countries as a team.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slight deepening on 「continue」—a commitment, not a task. Tired but not worn. The last line lands softly, like a door closing gently.
